title: 怪兽冒险：从捕捉到选择
Monster Quest: capture, trade and choose
intro: 不只是“抓到更多怪兽”。Martin 为自己的世界加入交易、培养和料理，让每次捕捉都产生不同的选择。
More than catching another monster: Martin adds trading, training and cooking, giving each capture a meaningful choice.
conclusion: V1 保留作对照；V2 独立重做，旧代码与存档不被覆盖。新循环已有测试证据，最终 Boss、完整双语与实体 iPad 验收仍未闭环。
V1 remains available for comparison. V2 is an independent rebuild with separate saves. Its new loop has test evidence; final bosses, full bilingual coverage and physical-iPad acceptance remain open.
next: 下一关：在真实 iPad 上复测操作与长流程，再由 Martin 确认画面、挑战和新玩法。
Next gate: real-iPad controls and sustained play, followed by Martin’s review of visuals, challenge and the new loop.

name: V1 · 3D 捕捉与进化
V1 · 3D capture and evolution
status: 历史基线 · 对照保留
strength: 已有探索、捕捉、队伍战斗、进化和三地区结构。
Exploration, capture, team battles, evolution and three regions already exist.
limit: 本课仍认为画面、反馈和内容深度不够；旧文档的“Production Ready”不作为今天的完整验收结论。
The lesson still identifies limited visual feedback and depth. Old “Production Ready” wording is not today’s acceptance verdict.

name: V2 · Wildbound
V2 · Wildbound
status: 新开发候选 · 可单机试玩
strength: 出售、购买、料理、培养进化和独立存档连接成可验证的循环。
Selling, buying, cooking, training/evolution and independent saves form a tested loop.
limit: 英语界面；部分地图模板复用。完整三 Boss 通关、音效试听和真实 iPad 尚未完成。
English UI and reused regional layouts. Full three-boss completion, audio listening and physical iPad remain unverified.

title: 保留核心，明确增强
Keep the core, specify the improvement
detail: 保留捕捉、成长、战斗和更强 Boss；扩大探索范围，增强造型、技能、音效与受击反馈。
Keep capture, growth, combat and stronger bosses; improve exploration, silhouettes, skills, sound and hit feedback.
check: 试玩时能指出具体增强发生在什么动作和画面。
Point to the exact action and visual that improved.

title: 让怪兽成为不同用途的资源
Give monsters alternative uses
detail: 捕获后可以留下培养、出售/交易，或转换为食物，再支持更强目标的狩猎。
A capture can be trained, sold/traded or converted into food to support tougher hunts.
owner: Martin 的方向，教师协助闭环
Martin’s direction, structured with teacher support
check: 完成一次捕捉→出售→买入，再完成一次料理与实际使用。
Complete capture → sale → purchase, then cook and actually use a meal.

title: 本轮不做建房
No building in this revision
detail: 讨论过建房，但没有形成足够明确的用途；最终明确排除，不让一个新词无限扩张范围。
Building was discussed but lacked a clear purpose and was explicitly excluded.
check: 不把旧场景中的小屋误认作新增建造系统。
Do not mistake a decorative hut for a new building mechanic.

title: 独立 V2，限时交付
Independent, timeboxed V2
detail: 从明确需求重做，不覆盖 V1。十五分钟是开发约束，不是自动通过所有测试的证明。
Rebuild from the aligned brief without overwriting V1. A 15-minute target does not certify every test.
check: 新旧入口、存档键与版本来源可分别核对。
Verify distinct entry points, save keys and source versions.

title: 从战斗小样到 3D 世界
From battle prototype to 3D world
brief: 历史日志记录地图、选人、可见怪物、3D 人物和稳定镜头的逐步补充。
Historical notes record requests for a map, trainer selection, visible monsters, 3D characters and steadier camera.
tools: 原型→现场反馈→场景与镜头修改
Prototype → classroom feedback → scene and camera changes
tech: Three.js、输入与战斗界面；历史文档中的根因和实机声明未在本轮全部重验。
Three.js, input and battle UI; historical root-cause/device claims were not all reverified here.
result: 形成今天评测的 V1，保留历史而不把旧结论当新证据。
Established V1 for today’s comparison; historical claims remain separately labelled.

title: 先评价，再说自己的特别之处
Review first, then define what makes it yours
brief: 教师要求先说优点和具体问题，再解释区别于既有抓宠游戏的独特玩法；反复澄清交易、食物和建房的目的。
The teacher asks for strengths, concrete problems and a distinct idea, repeatedly clarifying the purpose of trading, food and building.
tools: 轮流交流→教师追问用途→AI 复述→确认不做项
Discussion → questions about purpose → AI restatement → explicit exclusions
tech: 把抽象愿望转换为规则与闭环；这不是“所有项目都必须重做”的工程定律。
Translate broad wishes into rules and loops; this is not a rule that every project must be rebuilt.
result: 选择独立 V2；捕获物的多用途成为主线，不做建房。
Choose an independent V2 with alternative uses for captures and no building.

title: V2 实现与正常流程验证
V2 implementation and normal-path checks
brief: 交易、料理和成长必须真的改变怪兽、金币和状态，不是只有菜单。
Trading, cooking and growth must actually change monsters, coins and state, not just display menus.
tools: 新目录实现→语法检查→浏览器连贯操作→保留失败并修正测试夹具
New implementation → syntax → continuous browser actions → retain failure and correct the fixture
tech: 明确状态机；独立实体 ID；经济校验；异步战斗标记；独立存档键。
Explicit state ownership, entity IDs, economy checks, asynchronous battle tokens and a separate save key.
result: 正常捕捉/买卖/料理/进化/存档已有记录；边界夹具重跑通过，原失败仍保留。
Capture, economy, meals, evolution and saves have recorded checks. Boundary rerun passed; the original failed run is retained.

title: 归档与学习复盘
Archive and learning review
brief: 把学生决定、实现默认值、脚本测试和待验收项分开。
Separate student decisions, implementation defaults, automated tests and open acceptance gates.
tools: 双机核对→Git 版本核验→脱敏记录→HUB→发布读回
Cross-host inventory → Git verification → redacted records → HUB → live readback
tech: 版本清单与文件指纹让下一次开发能够从证据恢复。
Version inventory and file hashes make the work recoverable.
result: 新旧版本并列、需求可追踪，未替学生打分或宣布通关。
Comparable versions and traceable requirements, without invented student scores or completion.

title: 需求要说明用途
A requirement needs a purpose
practice: 围绕 building、交易和食物，先问“它在游戏里用来做什么”。
The class questions what building, trading and food actually do.
knowledge: 范围控制：没有清晰用途的功能不自动进入本轮。
Scope control: a feature without a clear purpose is not automatically included.
expression: “我希望玩家能……，因为……；这一轮先不做……”
“The player should be able to … because …; this revision excludes …”
level: 有课堂讨论证据；不等于独立掌握
Discussion evidenced; independent mastery not established

title: 把点子接成闭环
Connect ideas into a loop
practice: 把抓怪与训练、买卖、料理、再狩猎连接起来。
Connect capture to training, trade, meals and further hunting.
knowledge: 资源输入、转换和结果：每个按钮都应改变可解释的状态。
Resources have inputs, transformations and outcomes; every action should change an explainable state.
expression: “先做 A，得到 B，再用 B 做 C；最后回到更难的 A。”
“Do A to obtain B; use B for C, then return to a harder A.”
level: 需求实践已出现
Observed requirements practice

title: 安全的状态转换
Safe state transitions
practice: 实现中把战斗、商店、探索分开；测试禁止倒下伙伴继续出场。
The implementation separates battle, shop and exploration and tests invalid fallen-partner selection.
knowledge: 状态机、实体身份与操作校验，防止异步动作串进错误阶段。
State machines, entity identity and validation prevent actions from leaking into the wrong phase.
expression: “在什么状态允许？不满足条件时应该怎样拒绝？”
“In which state is this allowed? How should invalid input be rejected?”
level: 从实际代码提炼的课后工程复盘，不冒称课堂已教完
Code-grounded retrospective, not claimed as fully taught in class

title: 测试证据也会出错
Test evidence can fail too
practice: 正常路径完成后，低血量夹具被存档覆盖，导致边界测试失败；更正夹具后重跑。
A low-HP fixture was overwritten by saving after the normal flow; correcting its setup enabled the boundary rerun.
knowledge: 区分产品缺陷、测试夹具问题和最终实机验收；失败不能直接删掉。
Distinguish product faults, fixture problems and final device acceptance; preserve failed evidence.
expression: “我怎样测、预期什么、实际什么、这次证明了什么？”
“How did I test, what did I expect, what happened, and what does this prove?”
level: 工程记录可核验；学生掌握程度待观察
Verifiable engineering record; learner mastery remains unassessed

issues: 原组合测试有失败记录
正常流程检查已记录，但 results.json 的总状态为 failed，含合成指针错误与边界断言；后续边界重跑通过，不将首轮改写为全 PASS。
Normal-path checks were recorded, but the original report is failed with synthetic-pointer and boundary errors. The later boundary pass does not rewrite that run.
已保留；本轮不重跑全战役
Retained; no full campaign rerun here
完整三 Boss、音效、双语覆盖和真实 iPad 仍需分别验证。
Three-boss progression, audio, bilingual coverage and physical iPad need separate verification.
questions: 你抓到一只新怪物后，有哪三种不同的决定？
What three choices can you make after a capture?
为什么这一次不做建房？
Why did this revision leave building out?
怎样证明卖掉的是你选中的那只怪物？
How can you prove the correct monster was sold?
human_scope: 按当前 V2 加本次 HUB 重建一次估算；不重复叠加 V1 历史投入。
Estimate one rebuild of current V2 plus this HUB, without adding the V1 history again.
guide: V1 与 V2 都有独立浏览器单机入口；V2 先选训练师和伙伴，再跟随故事。可用屏幕方向键或点地标移动、互动按钮进入商店/厨房/战斗。V2 目前以英语呈现，完整中文、统一左栏与真实 iPad 操作不因接入 HUB 而自动合格。

Both V1 and V2 have independent browser-solo entries. In V2 choose a trainer and partner, follow the story, then use touch directions/landmarks and interaction controls. V2 remains English-led; full Chinese, a standard left rail and physical-iPad controls do not become certified merely by joining the HUB.

title: 三人共创：同一个世界，一起玩
Three creators, one shared world
intro: 从旧乐园的试玩出发，孩子们提出可复现的问题，再把想法对齐成大厅、乐园、野外和农场。两条 3D 分支都保留，不提前宣布谁获胜。
Start with the old park, describe reproducible problems, then align a lobby, park, wilderness and farm. Both 3D branches are retained for review; neither is declared a winner.
conclusion: 旧版是各玩各的单机；两条新线都加入共享世界。Astra《云间奇遇》有三连接与 HUD 修复证据，Opus《三人同乐世界》有触屏补丁；暂未记录教师最终取舍。

The old build is independent solo play. Both new branches add a shared world. Skyvale has three-connection and HUD-fix evidence; Trio World has a touch patch. The teacher’s final selection is not yet recorded.
next: 下一关：两条候选分别做三台真实 iPad 对照；先验收操作与任务可理解性，再决定保留或融合。
Next gate: compare both candidates on three physical iPads. Verify controls and understandable goals before selecting or merging.

name: Adventure World · 原单机
Adventure World · original solo
status: 旧版基线 · 单机可玩
strength: 孩子喜欢超能力、角色切换、声音反馈和喂狗/拾取。
Children liked powers, character switching, sound feedback, feeding the puppy and collecting.
limit: 课堂报告摇杆粘住、双击缩放与夜间目标不清；本轮不冒称已修好原版。
The class reported stuck joystick input, double-tap zoom and unclear night goals. This archive does not claim those old-build issues are fixed.

name: Astra · 云间奇遇 HUD 修复版
Astra · Skyvale HUD revision
status: 3D 联机候选 · 需服务器
strength: 三人共享任务与进度；服务端校验距离与房间人数。已有 HUD 裁切重现和六尺寸回归。
Shared tasks/progress, server-side distance checks and room limits. HUD clipping has reproduction and six-size regression evidence.
limit: 仍需真实三 iPad 修复后复测。房间存于内存；普通 Pages 无法运行它的 WebSocket 服务。
Needs post-fix testing on three physical iPads. Room state is memory-only; ordinary Pages cannot host its WebSocket service.

name: Opus · 三人同乐世界触屏版
Opus · Trio World touch revision
status: 3D 联机候选 · 需服务器
strength: 大厅与三区、三种能力、五套外观、天气、采集、喂养和五阶段小屋；触屏后补。
Lobby/three zones, three powers, five appearances, weather, collection, feeding and a five-stage cabin; touch was added later.
limit: 原交付先漏了无键盘条件；仅有模拟触屏与两标签同步记录，不等于三 iPad 验收。
Initial delivery omitted the no-keyboard constraint. Simulated touch and two-tab checks are not three-iPad acceptance.

title: 三个人真的在同一个世界
Three people in the same world
detail: 不是三个设备各自单机；第三人称 3D、类似 Roblox 的可见同伴和共享结果。
Not three independent games: third-person 3D with visible peers and shared outcomes.
owner: 三人课堂共创，教师确认
check: 一人采集/建屋，另外两端同时看到对应变化；另测离开和重连。
One player collects/builds and the other two see it; separately test leaving and rejoining.

title: 大厅连接三种体验
A lobby links three experiences
detail: 主题乐园保留超能力、换角色、声音；野外有果树、篝火和天气；农场喂动物、收产品、建小屋。
Powers, appearance changes and sound in the park; fruit, fire and weather outdoors; feeding, produce and a cabin on the farm.
check: 每个区域都能进入、知道目标并完成一个真实动作。
Reach each zone, understand its goal and perform a real action.

title: 好看、好玩，而且会玩
Looks good, feels good, makes sense
detail: 操作顺、不掉链子、任务指引清楚；首版不做灾难系统和自由抓取/编辑。
Smooth reliable controls and clear guidance; disasters and unrestricted grabbing/editing are deferred.
owner: 教师约束与学生体验反馈
check: 第一次玩的孩子能说出当前目标、下一步动作及完成反馈。
A first-time player can explain the goal, next action and completion feedback.

title: 大家都在用 iPad，没有键盘
Everyone is on iPad, without keyboards
detail: Opus 首版交付后再次明确这一条件；Joey 在蓝色 iPad 上具体报告底部 HUD 不完整。
The condition was reiterated after the Opus delivery. Joey specifically reported clipped bottom HUD controls on the blue iPad.
owner: 原始可见用户消息可核验
check: 摇杆与全部操作按钮都在实际可视区，可同时移动与操作，滑出/取消后停止。
All controls fit the visible viewport; simultaneous controls work and releasing/cancelling input stops movement.

title: 从共同点子到原单机乐园
Shared ideas become the original solo park
brief: 水上乐园、动物、小狗、飞行、隐形和夜游。每项是谁最先说的无法核实，保留共同署名。
Waterpark, animals, puppy, flight, invisibility and night exploration. Individual idea attribution is unverified.
tools: 课堂讨论→Spec→Canvas 实现→点按操作与旧验收
Discussion → spec → Canvas implementation → tap controls and historical QA
tech: 本地状态、任务、碰撞、绘制与存档分模块；无需联机服务。
Separate state, quests, collision, rendering and saves; no multiplayer server.
result: 成为 9 月 24 日课堂试玩的共同基线。
Creates the baseline used in the 24 September lesson.

title: 先试玩，再逐个说不同意见
Play first, then contribute distinct feedback
brief: 每人说不同的优点/问题，认真听前一个人；指出操作、位置和失败表现。课堂记录未有人完成旧版。
Each child contributes a distinct strength/problem, listens, and describes the action, location and failure. No completion was reported in that playtest.
tools: 单机核验→儿童试玩→口头评测→AI 汇总
Solo audit → children play → spoken review → AI synthesis
tech: 10/10 规则测试不等于儿童能够通关；夜间自动路径有失败，根因不能仅凭猜测。
10/10 rule tests do not prove children can finish. A night-route automation failed without establishing a definitive root cause.
result: 保留喜欢的能力/反馈，把触控和目标清晰度列为新版本核心。
Keep powers/feedback and make controls and clear goals priorities.

title: 同一份需求，两条独立实现
One aligned brief, two independent builds
brief: 确认不是修旧版，而是从零做第三人称 3D 共享世界；复杂编辑与灾难后置。
Confirm a fresh shared third-person 3D world instead of patching the old game; defer editing and disasters.
tools: AI 复述→教师确认→分别交给 Astra / Opus 实现
AI restatement → teacher confirmation → independent Astra / Opus implementation
tech: 共同需求与验收标准可一致，实现方式不必相同。
Requirements and acceptance can be shared without forcing identical implementations.
result: 版本并列保留，尚无最终淘汰或融合授权。
Retain both; no final rejection or merge decision is recorded.

title: Astra：云间奇遇与三端同步
Astra: Skyvale and three-client synchronization
brief: 共享星环、采果、生火、动物产物、三步小屋与大厅庆祝。
Shared rings, fruit, fire, animal produce, a three-step cabin and lobby celebration.
tools: 服务端→3D 场景→三条连接流程→独立浏览器→输入发送修复
Server → 3D scene → three-connection flow → independent browsers → input-transmission fix
tech: WebSocket 服务端推进世界；输入定时发送独立于渲染帧，避免慢帧导致移动不同步。
WebSocket server advances the world; timed input transmission is independent of rendering frames.
result: 网络主线与边界测试通过；真实 iPad 手感当时未验收。
Network flow/boundary tests passed; physical-iPad feel was not certified.

title: Opus：先桌面，再补无键盘触控
Opus: desktop first, then keyboard-free touch
brief: 首次交付只有键鼠，教师明确“我们要用 ipad 玩，没有键盘”；随后加入浮动摇杆、手势视角和触屏按钮。
The first delivery only had keyboard/mouse. The teacher reiterated iPad/no keyboard; a floating joystick, camera gestures and touch buttons followed.
tools: Node/Three.js/ws→双标签共享测试→触控补丁→横竖屏与名单避让
Node/Three.js/ws → two-tab shared tests → touch patch → orientation and roster spacing
tech: 采集、喂养与建屋消息广播；前端输入适配不是联机服务本身。
Messages broadcast collection, feeding and building; adapting input is distinct from networking.
result: 当前触屏文件已回收；初次生成的桌面快照单独保存，明确未经最终 QA。
Current touch files recovered; the initial desktop write is separately preserved as pre-QA.

title: Joey 报告 HUD 裁切，补丁有前后证据
Joey reports HUD clipping; before/after evidence
brief: Joey 先报身份和蓝色 iPad，再指出底部选项看不到；教师给这个现象命名为 HUD 显示不全。
Joey identifies himself and the blue iPad before reporting missing bottom controls; the teacher names the HUD problem.
tools: 保存修复前文件→复现可视区缩小→补丁→六尺寸/命中/触控取消测试→线上指纹
Save old files → reproduce reduced viewport → patch → six-size/hit/cancel tests → live fingerprints
tech: VisualViewport、safe-area、动态高度、16px 输入字号、旋转时释放输入。
VisualViewport, safe-area, dynamic height, 16px inputs and input release during rotation.
result: 修复文件与回归结果已落盘；模拟测试不代替孩子在原 iPad 上确认。
Patch files and regression evidence exist; simulations do not replace confirmation on the original iPad.

title: 先说证据，不只说“好玩/不好玩”
Give evidence, not just “good/bad”
practice: 轮流说不同意见，举出喜欢的音效和互动，描述摇杆、缩放与夜游卡点。
Take turns with distinct feedback, naming sounds/interactions and joystick, zoom and night-goal problems.
knowledge: 用户测试关注完成目标的实际障碍，不只看功能数量。
Usability testing examines real obstacles to goals, not just feature counts.
expression: “我在……做……，预期……，实际……；所以希望……”
“At … I did …; I expected … but saw …; therefore I suggest …”
level: 有课堂实践证据
Observed classroom practice

title: 把使用设备放进需求
Include the real device in the requirement
practice: 从“做多人游戏”补充到“大家都用 iPad，没有键盘”。
Refine “multiplayer game” to “everyone uses an iPad with no keyboard”.
knowledge: 功能完整不等于可用；输入方式、可视区和多人条件属于验收条件。
Feature completeness is not usability; input, viewport and networking belong in acceptance criteria.
expression: “谁用、在哪台设备、没有什么、必须完成什么动作。”
“Who uses it, on which device, without what, and which action must work.”
level: 原始反馈可核验；补充发生在返工阶段
Verified feedback, added during rework

title: 让 AI 复述，再授权
Ask the AI to restate before authorizing
practice: 世界结构、三人同服、首版重点和不做项被复述后，教师给出开发指令。
The world, shared play, priorities and exclusions are restated before the teacher authorizes development.
knowledge: 需求对齐与版本范围：确认结果和边界，而非只确认模型听见了。
Alignment and scope: confirm the intended result and boundaries, not merely that the model heard you.
expression: “请按你的理解复述：目标、场景、规则、不做项和怎样证明完成。”
“Restate the goal, scene, rules, exclusions and evidence of completion.”
level: 课堂实际采用
Used in the lesson

title: 聊天需要轮次和停顿
Conversation needs turns and pauses
practice: 教师要求听清别人、避免重复，并给 AI 一个可以回应的停顿。
The teacher asks students to listen, avoid repetition and leave a pause for the AI to respond.
knowledge: 多人协作中的信息分工：一次讲清一个完整意图，减少重叠和漏听。
Collaborative communication: state one complete intention at a time to reduce overlap and omissions.
expression: “我补充一个不同的点……说完了，请你复述。”
“I have one different point … that is all; please restate it.”
level: 已练习；不推断每人已熟练掌握
Practised; individual mastery not inferred

title: 单机、联机和展示托管是三件事
Solo play, networking and hosting differ
practice: 旧版三人共创但各自单机；新版本需要服务端共享世界；GitHub 保存源码与展示。
The old co-created game is solo; new builds need a shared server; GitHub stores code and the showcase.
knowledge: 客户端负责交互/渲染，服务端负责共享状态；Pages 静态页面不等于 WebSocket 服务。
Clients handle input/rendering; the server handles shared state. A static Pages site is not a WebSocket server.
expression: “这个状态只在我的设备上，还是大家共享？服务器关了会怎样？”
“Is this state local or shared? What happens if the server stops?”
level: 课堂现象＋实现记录的工程复盘
Retrospective grounded in class experience and code

title: HUD 修复要验证边界
A HUD fix needs boundary checks
practice: 以 Joey 的设备现象为起点，对比修复前后按钮是否处于可见区域并可命中。
Start with Joey’s report and compare whether controls are inside the visible area and hittable.
knowledge: 布局视口不一定等于实际可视区；浏览器工具栏、旋转和键盘都可能改变边界。
The layout viewport may differ from the visible viewport; browser bars, rotation and keyboards can change bounds.
expression: “哪台设备、哪个方向、哪块控件、边界在哪里、修完后怎样复测？”
“Which device/orientation/control/boundary, and how will we retest the fix?”
level: 教师现场命名；深入原理由代码与测试补充
Term introduced in class; deeper explanation comes from code/tests

issues: 摇杆出圈粘住、双击页面放大是课堂反馈；它们不能因为另一条 3D 分支改好而被标作旧版已修。
Stuck off-pad input and double-tap zoom are class reports; fixes in a separate 3D branch do not fix the old game.
孩子报告任务不清、未完成；有自动夜间路径失败，具体根因未确认。
Children reported unclear goals and no completion; an automated night route also failed without a confirmed cause.
新 brief 已纳入；旧版未关闭
In the new brief; old issue open
修复前文件和六组可视区回归保留；触摸拖出并取消后输入归零。还缺原设备修复后确认。
Pre-fix files and six viewport cases retained; off-pad touch cancellation resets input. Confirmation on the original device is missing.
补丁已落盘；实机待确认
18:40 明确 iPad 条件，18:45 交付触屏补丁；不是原始桌面版本从一开始就满足要求。
The iPad constraint was reiterated at 18:40 and the touch patch delivered at 18:45; the original desktop build did not meet it.
触屏补丁保留，实机验收待定
Touch patch retained; device acceptance open
questions: 三个人各开一个网页，为什么不一定是联机？
Why are three open webpages not necessarily multiplayer?
请用“设备→动作→预期→实际”再报告一个问题。
Report one issue as device → action → expected → actual.
两版各有哪一点值得保留？你怎样验证，而不是凭模型名字决定？
What is worth keeping from each build, and how would you test it without judging by the model’s name?
human_scope: 估算重建一套具备当前共同范围的 3D 原型及 HUB；不把两种模型的历史工作机械相加。
Estimate one 3D prototype with the shared current scope plus HUB, not a mechanical sum of both model histories.
guide: 在家可直接打开旧 Adventure World 单机。两条 3D 候选的完整源码与电脑运行包都已归档，但需要 Node/WebSocket 服务器，不能把 GitHub Pages 地址当成三人联机服务。下载包内含运行所需 ws；电脑预装 Node 后运行对应 start 命令。Skyvale 默认仅监听本机，跨设备需要教师配置授权的代理/隧道；Opus 可在同一受信任局域网测试。两版均无账户和持久云存档，不宜作为无人值守公网服务。

The old Adventure World can be played solo at home. Both 3D candidates have archived source and computer runtime packages but require a Node/WebSocket server. Their Pages paths are not multiplayer services. Runtime ws is bundled; Node must already be installed. Skyvale listens on loopback and needs a teacher-authorized proxy/tunnel for other devices; Opus supports testing on a trusted LAN. Neither has accounts or persistent cloud saves, so neither is an unattended public service.
